scientific_limitations: Payoff-weighted calibration presupposes an existing strictly interior periodic solution; it does not prove general orbit existence or global attraction.
The unweighted strict mean depression is proved for pairwise groups N=2; weights can depend on both state and forcing for N>2.
The analytically constructed stable periodic response is local and requires sufficiently small sinusoidal environmental forcing at the given rational parameters.
The exact leading coefficient follows from analytic perturbation theory; numerical integration is corroborative rather than proof of the universal identity.
title: Exact cooperation balance and fluctuation penalty under periodic environmental forcing
